title: Weirdwood Manor 2
description:
I spent over a year at Relish working on the sequel to their storybook mobile game, Weirdwood Manor 2. The idea was to build a custom storybook game framework at the same time, for use in future titles.

![](/assets/projects/career/weirdwood-manor-2/screenshot-4.webp)

The first phase of the project for me was graphics research—I was tasked with improving visual quality while maintaining performance on mobile devices. I ended up building things like a custom skin shader with subsurface scattering, and special effects like the ghost shader shown below.

![](/assets/projects/career/weirdwood-manor-2/screenshot-3.webp)

The project itself was fun to build, but poorly managed and wildly off schedule, so in the end we didn't come close to the storybook engine we dreamed of, and Weirdwood Manor 2 wasn't published until three years after I left.

![](/assets/projects/career/weirdwood-manor-2/screenshot-2.webp)
